content.text: Retries go out one second apart, which is useless when an endpoint is down for minutes. Back off exponentially instead: 2s, 4s, 8s and so on, capped at 5 minutes.

payload.name: apply_patch
payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: relay/config.py
@@
 # Seconds to wait for a customer endpoint to answer.
 TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
 
-# Seconds between two attempts.
-RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS = 1
+# The wait doubles after every failed attempt, up to the cap.
+BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS = 2
+BACKOFF_CAP_SECONDS = 300
 
 SIGNING_SECRET = os.environ.get("RELAY_SIGNING_SECRET", "")
*** End Patch
